name: icons-r6
note: UI icons round 6 (owner, 2026-11-01): the header set redone as system-style glyphs (a classic shopping bag for Store, a standard gear, a standard share arrow) with the round-5 Chat bubble as the exemplar; Gems, Health and Money dropped (the game keeps its own icons for those for now). 3 x 3 grid. Two candidates.

header.prompt: SUBJECTS: nine icons for the game's top bar, in order on the 3 x 3 grid, left to right then top to bottom, each the standard system glyph for its function: 1 STORE: a classic shopping bag with two rounded handles, seen from the front, the familiar checkout icon. 2 INBOX: a closed envelope seen from the flap side, the familiar mail icon. 3 SETTINGS: the familiar settings gear: a round cog with eight evenly spaced rounded teeth and a round hole in the centre, flat to the picture plane. 4 LEADERS: a laurel wreath open at the top with a small golden star inside it. 5 CHAT: the exemplar speech bubble with three dots, redrawn exactly. 6 HELP: a bold question mark inside a round cream disc, the familiar help icon. 7 SHARE: the familiar share icon: a bold arrow curving up and out to the right from an open tray or box. 8 LEVEL: a golden five-point star. 9 PROFILE: the familiar profile icon: a round head above rounded shoulders, as a cream silhouette on a honey-wood disc.
